# Kaan Dikeç

> Abdurrahman Kaan Dikeç (also written Kaan Dikeç or Kaan Dikec; GitHub: dikeckaan) is a computer engineer, developer and musician from Istanbul, Türkiye. Most of his work is close to the hardware: he created mu300-linux, which runs a full Ubuntu or OpenWrt next to Android on the ZTE F50, MU300 and U30 Air 5G hotspots (Unisoc T760 / UMS9620), together with a flashing toolkit, a VPN module and a family of Magisk modules for those devices. He also builds native macOS apps (easy-vphone), Hackintosh EFIs, a Forza Horizon telemetry dashboard and networking / VPN tools. Almost all of it is open source on GitHub.

Numbers as of 2026-10-29: 98 original public repositories (165 including forks), 917 stars and 395 forks on his own repositories, 87 GitHub followers.

## Most-starred projects

- [mu300-linux](https://github.com/dikeckaan/mu300-linux): Linux (Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 or OpenWrt) next to Android on the ZTE F50 / MU300 and U30 Air 5G hotspots (Unisoc T760 / UMS9620): installer, vendor 5.4 and mainline 6.18 / 7.2 kernels, 5G modem, Wi-Fi, battery, LEDs, NFC, findings (website: https://kaandikec.com/mu300-linux/) (725 stars)
- [zte-f50-toolkit](https://github.com/dikeckaan/zte-f50-toolkit): ZTE F50 (5G MiFi) flashing toolkit — B09 downgrade, root, BL unlock, IMEI patch. Built on a custom spd_dump fork. (45 stars)
- [MacOS-Workflow-VNC](https://github.com/dikeckaan/MacOS-Workflow-VNC): A free macOS desktop over VNC in about five minutes, running on GitHub Actions runners with an ngrok tunnel. (16 stars)
- [macjaro](https://github.com/dikeckaan/macjaro): MacOS theme for Manjaro Gnome or any Arch based Gnome (15 stars)
- [easy-vphone](https://github.com/dikeckaan/easy-vphone): Native macOS GUI for vphone-cli with VM management and an integrated IPA library (11 stars)
- [mu300-linux-vpn](https://github.com/dikeckaan/mu300-linux-vpn): VPN toolkit for MU300 Linux (ZTE F50 / U30 Air): one command for Xray, sing-box, mihomo, WireGuard and OpenVPN profiles, as a module for Ubuntu and OpenWrt (11 stars)
- [f50-magisk-modules](https://github.com/dikeckaan/f50-magisk-modules): Index of Magisk modules for ZTE F50 (rooted Android, Unisoc UMS9620). Each module auto-updates via updateJson; statusbot has /update command. (6 stars)
- [mf286r-telnet-openwrt-exploit](https://github.com/dikeckaan/mf286r-telnet-openwrt-exploit): This guide provides step-by-step instructions to enable Telnet access on the ZTE MF286R router with stock firmware. It also includes advanced options for flashing OpenWRT firmware and recovering the router via a serial connection. Proceed with caution, as some actions may result in bricking the device. (5 stars)
- [internetmerge](https://github.com/dikeckaan/internetmerge): Bond multiple network links into faster total internet — cross-platform, Mac-first (Connectify Dispatcher style) (5 stars)
- [OpenEUICC-5ber](https://github.com/dikeckaan/OpenEUICC-5ber): OpenEUICC build with 5ber eSIM support: a free, open-source Local Profile Assistant for Android. (5 stars)
- [magisk-zte-f50-ims-voice-fix](https://github.com/dikeckaan/magisk-zte-f50-ims-voice-fix): Magisk overlay for ZTE F50 IMS apk — patches the PhoneStateMonitor SCREEN_OFF handler to stop call drops on screen lock. UNDER DEVELOPMENT: root cause not yet confirmed. (4 stars)
- [magisk-zte-f50-statusbot](https://github.com/dikeckaan/magisk-zte-f50-statusbot): Telegram bot for ZTE F50 (rooted Android): status, AT, shell, ZTE perf, IMEI/SMS, tailscale toggle, speedtest, /update via GitHub (4 stars)
